correctness.rationale: Lower bound: the shorter non-synchronizing prefixes force a strict rank drop at power a and a nonzero a-th power, so the difference space has dimension at least a+1. Upper bound: the explicit singular shift and plane rotation have unique shortest zero word 0^a1^n0, because every zero product requires at least a+1 zeros and n ones. Full reachable-span and completely positive depolarizing-perturbation arguments realize that word in complex dimension ceil(sqrt(a+2)). The packaged finite checker passed 126400 evaluations; finite evidence does not replace the proof.
